_comment: Tier-2 for febio::viscoelasticity#0. The shipped DYNAMIC step-loaded relaxation deck flips the sign of its logged sz on nearly every step and its peak |sz| exceeds its final |sz| — the amplitude does not decay. The same deck under STATIC gives ZERO sign changes and a final stress of the correct compressive sign. Refining the step tenfold makes both the peak and the sign-change count WORSE, which is what rules out step-size convergence error. All three runs reach normal termination with exit 0, so the banner tells you nothing. Counts and peaks are computed by the fixture; no number is carried in the catalogue text. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
